case.summary: Customer C11923 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $131.30 on card C11923-K2. Investigation revealed the transaction was made using a new device profile (SM-G610F Build/NRD90M) that has been linked to three other cards within a four-day period. The transaction amount significantly exceeds the cardholder's typical spending pattern. Based on the customer's denial and the shared device profile, the activity is confirmed as fraud.

sar.narrative: On 2016-12-29, an unauthorized online transaction of $131.30 (ID 3583368) was processed on card C11923-K2 belonging to customer C11923. The customer contacted the bank to report they did not authorize this purchase. The transaction was conducted via a mobile device (SM-G610F Build/NRD90M) that was not previously associated with the customer's account. Further analysis of the knowledge graph showed this specific device profile was used to attempt similar transactions on three other cards (C03938-K1, C05595-K1, and C05678-K1) between 2016-12-28 and 2016-12-31. The transaction amount of $131.30 is nearly four times the cardholder's average purchase size. This pattern of using a single new device across multiple unrelated accounts is indicative of a coordinated fraud attempt. The customer confirmed they still possess the physical card and that no authorized users had access to the device. Consequently, the card has been blocked and a report is being filed due to the connection with a shared device profile.

stop_reason: Investigation concluded under policy section 6 as the customer confirmed the transaction was unauthorized and the case involves a shared device profile.
